items.title: New charter gives River Wye the right to be free from pollution
items.description: The Wye has become the first river in the UK to have a charter covering it from source to sea.

items.title: Kane's hat trick seals Bayern Munich's 21st German Cup win
items.description: Harry Kane scored three times to fire Bayern Munich to a 3-0 victory over Stuttgart in the German Cup final. The win delivered a domestic double for the Bavarian giants and ended a six-year trophy drought.

items.title: UK swelters as hottest May day for nearly 80 years hits

items.title: Cyprus election expected to shake up national politics
items.description: Cyprus goes to the polls to elect a new parliament on Sunday. The vote is expected to reshape the country's political landscape, weaken traditional parties and accelerate the rise of new anti-establishment movements.

items.title: In Japan, divorce splits parents from children. Could a law change end sole custody?
items.description: An amendment to Japan's Civil Code looks set to allow shared parenting for the first time.

items.title: Displaced Ukrainians risk home seizure under Russian law
items.description: Russia is tightening control over property in occupied Ukrainian territories, requiring owners to register under Russian law. Many Ukrainians say returning to do so would put their safety and freedom at risk.
